name: Choukyou Katei ~Sei Kaihatsu Sareta Shitai wa Moto Kare o Wasurerarenai~
original_name: 調教カテイ ～性開発された肢体は元カレを忘れられない～
source:
Wakana Sasamoto was living a happy married life as Kotaro’s wife.
But Wakana had a secret she hadn’t told Kotaro.
That she is a woman who has already been trained—
And that Kotaro alone cannot satisfy her—
She had been trained by Masato Akihara, her boyfriend from college.
The purchase of their long-awaited home…
And, as luck would have it, their next-door neighbor is none other than her ex-boyfriend, Masato.
Now a married woman, Wakana’s body craves Masato and is once again put through his training.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01000639.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
笹本若菜身为幸太郎的妻子，过着幸福美满的婚姻生活。
然而若菜心中却藏着一个未曾向幸太郎坦白的秘密：
她其实早已是一个身体被彻底开发调教过的女人——
单凭幸太郎一人，根本无法满足她的身体——
早在大学时代，她便已被当时的男友秋原雅斗调教得食髓知味。
如今夫妻俩终于买下了期盼已久的新房……
岂料造化弄人，住在隔壁的邻居竟然正是她的前男友雅斗。
已为人妻的若菜，身体再次渴求起雅斗的触碰，一步步重陷于他的调教之中。
